from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfit(BaseModel):
    """Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name as stated in the financial report")
    profit_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used in the report for net profit, e.g. '归属于上市公司股东的净利润'")
    profit_amount: float | None = Field(description="Signed net profit amount; losses are negative values")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period this figure covers, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the profit figure and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profits: list[CompanyProfit]
